title: PongLens
tagline: Get paid to review your students' matches.

lines.text: PongLens is where table tennis coaches get paid to review their students' matches.

lines.label: What you sell
lines.text: You decide what a review includes, what it costs, and how many days you need.

lines.label: Your page
lines.text: Everything you sell sits on one page, with your background and what your players have said about you.

lines.label: Your page
lines.text: Send that link to your students, or put the code up at the club.

lines.label: Getting set up
lines.text: Payments run through Stripe. You connect it once, and it pays your bank.

lines.label: A new order
lines.text: When a student buys a review, they send you one of their matches and answer your questions.

lines.label: A new order
lines.text: You read their answers before you decide, then accept or decline. Nothing starts until you accept.

lines.label: What arrives
lines.text: The match arrives with the standing around already cut out. Every point is its own clip, with the score on the picture.

lines.label: Doing the review
lines.text: So you are not scrolling a video looking for a rally. You watch, and you write what you saw.

lines.label: Doing the review
lines.text: Then you attach the points that show it, and your student watches exactly what you mean.

lines.label: Doing the review
lines.text: Or say it out loud instead of typing, and your words arrive as text.

lines.label: What they get
lines.text: Your student gets your review with a clip on every point you picked, and it stays in their account.

lines.label: Getting paid
lines.text: When the review is finished, Stripe sends your share to your bank.
PongLens. Get paid to review your students' matches.
